en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a lively city square with a prominent fountain in the foreground, surrounded by greenery and ornate fencing. Historic multi-story buildings line the street, with one featuring a sign for a dentist ('Zahnarzt'). In the background, a baroque-style church with a tall, ornate clock tower dominates the scene. There are also two green trams and people walking or standing around, indicating a bustling urban setting. The overall style and colorization suggest an early 20th-century period. The text 'Graz - Bismarckplatz.' appears in the upper right corner.
